passages.provision_quote: For the following compliance periods, the quantities shall reflect reasonable progress in each of the intervening years sufficient to ensure that the procurement of electricity products from eligible renewable energy resources achieves 25 percent of retail sales by December 31, 2016, 33 percent by December 31, 2020, 44 percent by December 31, 2024, 52 percent by December 31, 2027, and 60 percent by December 31, 2030.
passages.note: Chaptered text of SB 100, a single-subject renewables portfolio standard bill raising the binding dated procurement percentages for retail sellers and publicly owned utilities.

rows.reasoning: Stern voted Aye on final concurrence in SB 100 (2017-2018), a single-subject renewables portfolio standard bill whose operative text binds retail sellers and publicly owned utilities to procurement that "achieves 25 percent of retail sales by December 31, 2016, 33 percent by December 31, 2020, 44 percent by December 31, 2024, 52 percent by December 31, 2027, and 60 percent by December 31, 2030." That is a legal requirement to procure clean energy attached to firm deadlines, which matches "Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines" clause for clause. The bill's separate 100-percent-by-2045 "policy of the state" clause is only a goal and does not carry the chair, but the dated binding percentages beside it do.
